name: @kobralink/desktop
description: Kobralink desktop (macOS) — embeds the local bridge API.

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-vc-redist.cjs && KOBRALINK_BUNDLE_OS=win32 KOBRALINK_BUNDLE_ARCHS=x64 bun run dist -- --win --x64
scripts.dist: bun run --filter @kobralink/api bundle && bun run --filter @kobralink/web build && bunx electron-vite build && bunx electron-builder --publish never
